- G border at rows[17-22], cols[16-21] (around cross 1)
- g marks at rows[18-21], cols[29-32] (a cross shape between crosses 2 and 3)
The g marks form a cross shape:
- Row 18: cols 30-31 (horizontal bar)
- Rows 19-20: col 29 (left vertical) and col 32 (right vertical)
- Row 21: cols 30-31 (horizontal bar)
Wait, that's not quite a cross. Let me look at it more carefully:
- g at rows[18-18], cols[30-31] → (18,30), (18,31)
- g at rows[19-20], cols[29-29] → (19,29), (20,29)
- g at rows[19-20], cols[32-32] → (19,32), (20,32)
- g at rows[21-21], cols[30-31] → (21,30), (21,31)
This forms a diamond/rhombus shape! The g marks are at the positions that would form a cross/diamond centered around (19.5, 30.5), which is between crosses 2 and 3.
So the pattern is:
1. Click cross 1 → G border on cross 1, g diamond between crosses 2-3
2. Click cross 2 → G border moves to cross 2, g diamond moves somewhere else
3. Click cross 3 → Everything resets
4. Click crosses 4-5 → No effect (because board was reset)
Now clicking cross 1 again reproduced the same pattern. So the game loops back to the start after the reset.
The g diamond between crosses 2-3 might be indicating "skip cross 2, go to cross 3" or "the next target is between crosses 2 and 3".
Wait, let me reconsider. Maybe the g marks indicate a "bridge" or "path" that needs to be filled. Or maybe they indicate the next cross to click.
Looking at the positions:
- Cross 1: center ~19, 18
- Cross 2: center ~19, 24
- Cross 3: center ~19, 36
The g diamond is at cols 29-32, rows 18-21, which is between crosses 2 and 3.
Hmm, what if the g marks indicate where a new cross should appear? Or what if I need to click on the g marks themselves?
Actually, let me reconsider the whole mechanic. What if:
1. Clicking a cross "activates" it (G border)
2. The g marks indicate the NEXT cross to click
3. The g marks form a cross shape pointing toward the next target
But the g marks are between crosses 2 and 3, not on either one. Maybe the g marks indicate I should click on THAT position (the space between crosses)?
Let me try clicking on the g marks (center ~19, 30) and see what happens.
